FN-W1BXL59-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 101
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Leigh Hulsey
Security
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 101 as introduced would authorize the issuance of a distinctive motor vehicle license
plate to individuals diagnosed with invisible disabilities and to the primary caregivers of those
individuals upon payment of the standard $23 issuance fee and an additional annual fee of $40
to be distributed as follows:
2.5% Commission to License Plate Issuing Official $1.00
Department of Corrections $1.50
Department of Revenue-Administrative Cost $1.00
Kulturecity, Incorporated $36.50
Total $40.00
Page 1
